📖 How to use

  1. Enter the lease terms: down payment, monthly payment, months and disposition fee.
  2. Enter the buy terms: price, down payment, rate, loan term and estimated resale value.
  3. Read the total cost of each and the verdict.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the two totals calculated?

Leasing costs: down payment + (monthly payment × months) + disposition fee. Buying costs: down payment + (loan payment × months) − estimated resale value.

Does this include mileage overage fees?

No — mileage overage penalties, wear-and-tear charges and lease taxes vary by contract and are not modeled here.

When does leasing make more sense?

Buying usually wins if you keep cars long after the loan is paid; leasing wins if you always want a newer car with lower monthly payments and no resale hassle.
